entries.en: I still keep in touch with the friends I made during that summer course.
entries.zh: 我仍然与那年暑期课程中结识的朋友保持联络。

entries.en: She arrived at the station with two excited children in tow.
entries.zh: 她带着两个兴奋的孩子来到了车站。

entries.en: The piano sounds much better now that it is in tune.
entries.zh: 钢琴调准音后，听起来好多了。

entries.en: His flute was not quite in tune with the violin beside him.
entries.zh: 他的长笛和旁边的小提琴音调还不完全相合。

entries.en: I'm still in two minds about accepting a job so far from home.
entries.zh: 对于是否接受一份离家这么远的工作，我仍然犹豫不决。

entries.en: At the conductor's signal, the children lifted their hands in unison.
entries.zh: 指挥一示意，孩子们就一齐举起了手。

entries.en: Keep the red lighthouse in view as you follow the path along the cliffs.
entries.zh: 沿着悬崖边的小路走时，要一直能看见那座红色灯塔。

entries.en: In view of the heavy rain, we moved the outdoor concert into the school hall.
entries.zh: 考虑到大雨，我们把露天音乐会移到了学校礼堂。

entries.en: Everyone helped clean the kitchen, including the guests who had arrived that morning.
entries.zh: 大家都帮忙打扫了厨房，包括当天早晨才到的客人。

entries.en: I packed a light jacket instead of the thick coat you suggested.
entries.zh: 我装了一件薄夹克，没有带你建议的厚外套。

entries.en: The team put its emergency plan into action when the lights went out.
entries.zh: 灯熄灭时，团队实施了应急计划。

entries.en: My shopping list seems to have vanished into thin air between the kitchen and the car.
entries.zh: 我的购物清单好像在从厨房到汽车的这段路上消失得无影无踪了。

entries.meaningZh: 轻而易举地；毫不费力地
entries.en: After a little oil, the old sewing machine ran like a dream.
entries.zh: 上了一点油后，那台旧缝纫机运转得顺畅极了。

entries.term: like a hot knife through butter
entries.en: The new cutter went through the thick foam like a hot knife through butter.
entries.zh: 新切割器轻而易举地切开了厚泡沫。

entries.en: The manager came down on us like a ton of bricks for leaving the door unlocked.
entries.zh: 因为我们没有锁门，经理气势汹汹地把我们训了一顿。

entries.en: We ran like anything when we saw the last bus pulling away.
entries.zh: 看到末班公交车正要开走，我们拼命追赶。

entries.en: We chose a small hotel near to the station so we could walk there.
entries.zh: 我们选了一家靠近车站的小旅馆，这样就可以步行过去。

entries.en: The suitcase was none the worse for its tumble down the stairs.
entries.zh: 行李箱从楼梯上滚了下去，却没有损坏。

entries.en: Those two neighbours are two of a kind, always finding something to argue about.
entries.zh: 那两位邻居真是同一类人，总能找到事情争吵。

entries.en: We made a shelter of a sort with a blanket and two broken chairs.
entries.zh: 我们用一条毯子和两把破椅子勉强搭了个避身处。

entries.en: Of all people in our group, Maya knew the mountain paths best.
entries.zh: 在我们这群人中，玛雅最熟悉那些山路。

entries.en: A pencil is my tool of choice when I sketch ideas for a new design.
entries.zh: 为新设计画构思草图时，我喜欢选用铅笔。

entries.en: The colour of the folder is of no account; we need the papers inside.
entries.zh: 文件夹的颜色并不重要；我们需要的是里面的文件。

entries.en: The exhibition brought together paintings by several local artists of note.
entries.zh: 这次展览汇集了几位当地著名艺术家的画作。

entries.en: The photographs showed the crowded markets of old, before the wide roads were built.
entries.zh: 那些照片展示了修建宽阔道路之前，从前市场的拥挤景象。

entries.en: We were of one mind about keeping the library open on Saturday mornings.
entries.zh: 对于周六上午继续开放图书馆，我们意见一致。

entries.en: The festival invited a pianist of repute to perform in the restored theatre.
entries.zh: 音乐节邀请了一位享有盛名的钢琴家在修复后的剧院演出。

entries.en: The problem of the moment was finding enough chairs for the unexpected guests.
entries.zh: 眼下的问题是为那些意外到来的客人找到足够的椅子。

entries.en: Repairs would cost of the order of five hundred pounds, according to the written estimate.
entries.zh: 根据那份书面估价，修理大约需要五百英镑。

entries.en: She was of two minds about selling the bicycle she had ridden for years.
entries.zh: 对于是否卖掉骑了多年的自行车，她犹豫不决。

entries.en: These old maps may be of use when we plan the walking route.
entries.zh: 我们规划徒步路线时，这些旧地图可能派得上用场。

entries.en: The unexpected question caught me off balance, and I asked for a moment to think.
entries.zh: 那个意外的问题让我措手不及，我请求给我一点时间思考。

entries.en: Your guess about the missing money is off base; the bank transfer was simply delayed.
entries.zh: 你对那笔不见了的钱的猜测完全不对；只是银行转账延迟了。

entries.en: The receptionist was off duty, so we left the keys in the locked box.
entries.zh: 接待员不当班，所以我们把钥匙放进了上锁的盒子里。

entries.en: The local radio station went off the air during the power cut.
entries.zh: 停电期间，当地广播电台停止了播出。

entries.en: His answer was off the mark because he had misunderstood what the question was asking.
entries.zh: 他的回答不切题，因为他误解了题目的意思。

entries.en: The smaller room's rent was on a par with that of the larger flat nearby.
entries.zh: 这间较小房间的租金与附近那套较大公寓的租金相当。

entries.en: The shop let regular customers buy groceries on account and pay at the end of the month.
entries.zh: 商店允许老顾客赊购食品杂货，月底再付款。

entries.en: The ferry was cancelled on account of strong winds across the bay.
entries.zh: 由于海湾上风力强劲，渡轮停航了。

entries.en: On balance, the quieter flat suits us better, despite its smaller kitchen.
entries.zh: 总的说来，虽然厨房较小，那套更安静的公寓还是更适合我们。

entries.en: An electrician remained on call throughout the festival in case any equipment failed.
entries.zh: 整个音乐节期间都有一名电工待命，以防设备发生故障。

entries.en: She was on cloud nine after hearing that her first play would be performed.
entries.zh: 听说自己的第一部剧本将被搬上舞台，她欣喜若狂。

entries.en: Their agreement made the loan repayable on demand rather than on a fixed date.
entries.zh: 双方的协议规定，借款应要求立即偿还，而不是在固定日期偿还。

entries.en: Ask the librarian on duty where the old newspapers are kept.
entries.zh: 问问值班的图书管理员，那些旧报纸存放在哪里。

entries.en: Waiting for the interview had left me on edge all morning.
entries.zh: 等候面试让我整个上午都紧张不安。

entries.en: During the school holidays, we could spend hours on end building models in the shed.
entries.zh: 学校放假时，我们会连续好几个小时在棚屋里制作模型。

entries.en: The smaller clubs wanted to compete on equal terms with their wealthier rivals.
entries.zh: 那些较小的俱乐部希望在平等的条件下与更富有的对手竞争。

entries.en: We kept a copy of every signed form on file in the office.
entries.zh: 我们把每份已签字表格的复印件都存放在办公室的档案中。

entries.en: We left the bicycles at the gate and continued on foot through the gardens.
entries.zh: 我们把自行车留在门口，步行穿过花园。

entries.en: Our goalkeeper was on form and saved three difficult shots before halftime.
entries.zh: 我们的守门员状态很好，半场结束前扑出了三次难接的射门。

entries.en: From on high, the winding river looked like a silver thread across the fields.
entries.zh: 从高处看，那条蜿蜒的河流像一根横穿田野的银线。

entries.en: We put the kitchen renovation on hold until we knew how much the roof repairs would cost.
entries.zh: 在弄清修理屋顶的费用之前，我们暂缓了厨房翻修。

entries.meaningZh: 在狱中；被关押着〔美式非正式用语〕
entries.en: In the crime novel, the prisoner spends years on ice before plotting his escape.
entries.zh: 在那部犯罪小说里，囚犯被关押多年后才开始谋划越狱。

entries.en: The terminal stayed on line while the operator checked the connection to the main computer.
entries.zh: 操作员检查与主机的连接时，终端一直保持联机状态。

entries.en: On no account should you share the password printed inside this envelope.
entries.zh: 你决不能把印在这个信封里的密码告诉别人。

entries.en: There were several handmade lamps on offer at the weekend market.
entries.zh: 周末市场上有几盏手工灯具出售。

entries.en: The replacement part is on order, so the workshop cannot finish the repair yet.
entries.zh: 替换零件已经订购，但尚未到货，所以修理车间还无法完成维修。

entries.en: In the story, the king forbids anyone to enter the tower on pain of exile.
entries.zh: 在故事里，国王禁止任何人进入那座塔，违者将被流放。

entries.en: She refused to read the private letter on principle, even though she was curious.
entries.zh: 尽管好奇，她还是出于原则拒绝阅读那封私人信件。

entries.en: The committee wanted its objection on record before the final vote.
entries.zh: 委员会希望在最终投票前把自己的反对意见记录在案。

entries.en: The winter coats were on sale, with every price reduced by a quarter.
entries.zh: 冬季外套在降价出售，每件都便宜了四分之一。

entries.en: On second thought, I'll bring a torch as well as a spare phone battery.
entries.zh: 转念一想，除了备用手机电池，我还是再带一把手电筒吧。

entries.en: On second thoughts, we decided to leave the fragile vase at home.
entries.zh: 进一步考虑后，我们决定把那只易碎的花瓶留在家里。

entries.en: The carpenter measured the broken panels on site before returning to the workshop.
entries.zh: 木匠回车间前，在现场量了那些破损的板材。

entries.en: When the whole team is on song, even difficult passes seem effortless.
entries.zh: 全队处于最佳状态时，连高难度的传球看起来都毫不费力。

entries.en: I'm still on speaking terms with my former business partner, despite our disagreement.
entries.zh: 尽管意见不合，我仍然与从前的生意伙伴有说话往来。

entries.en: Your comments about the weak ending were on target and helped me revise the story.
entries.zh: 你对结尾薄弱之处的评论很准确，帮助我修改了故事。

entries.en: We were on tenterhooks until the missing dog finally came through the gate.
entries.zh: 直到那只走失的狗终于从门口进来，我们才不再焦虑不安。

entries.en: The venue has plenty of parking, so we have nothing to worry about on that score.
entries.zh: 场地有充足的停车位，所以在那一点上我们不必担心。

entries.en: The presenter checked her notes just before the programme went on the air.
entries.zh: 节目开始播出前，主持人检查了笔记。

entries.en: The drawing shows a person lying on the back with both arms stretched out.
entries.zh: 图中画着一个仰卧、双臂伸开的人。

entries.en: Another rent increase came on the back of the sharp rise in heating bills.
entries.zh: 取暖费大幅上涨之后，房租紧接着又涨了。

entries.en: The new assistant was on the ball and spotted the missing page immediately.
entries.zh: 新助理很敏锐，马上发现少了一页。

entries.en: Tap your foot on the beat while I play the melody more slowly.
entries.zh: 我把旋律弹慢一点时，你跟着节拍跺脚。

entries.en: She cut the fabric on the bias to make the ribbon bend more smoothly.
entries.zh: 她斜着裁剪布料，让那条布带弯曲起来更顺畅。

entries.en: The kitchen light is on the blink, so we're eating in the sitting room.
entries.zh: 厨房的灯坏了，所以我们在客厅吃饭。

entries.en: A move to a larger office is on the cards if the team keeps growing.
entries.zh: 如果团队继续扩大，就有可能搬到更大的办公室。

entries.en: We furnished the flat on the cheap with secondhand tables and borrowed chairs.
entries.zh: 我们用二手桌子和借来的椅子，花很少的钱布置了公寓。

entries.en: The repeated questions put the speaker on the defensive before she could explain her proposal.
entries.zh: 接连不断的问题让发言人还没来得及解释提案，就陷入了被动防守。

entries.en: Please fetch the spare chairs on the double; the audience is already arriving.
entries.zh: 请赶紧把备用椅子拿来；观众已经陆续到了。

entries.en: With deliveries arriving at both doors, the café staff were on the hop all morning.
entries.zh: 两边的门都有送货的人来，咖啡馆员工整个上午都在到处忙碌。

entries.en: A thin line of clouds appeared on the horizon as we reached the beach.
entries.zh: 我们到达海滩时，地平线上出现了一条细细的云带。

entries.term: on the horns of a dilemma
entries.en: With two equally urgent invitations for the same evening, I found myself on the horns of a dilemma.
entries.zh: 两份邀请都在同一天晚上，都同样急需回应，我左右为难。

entries.en: The clock in the hall strikes on the hour but remains silent at night.
entries.zh: 大厅里的钟每逢整点报时，但夜间不响。

entries.en: The owner brought us coffee on the house after the long delay with our meal.
entries.zh: 因为我们的饭菜耽搁了很久，店主免费给我们送来了咖啡。

entries.en: Attendance at the evening classes is on the increase, so we need another room.
entries.zh: 晚间课程的出席人数正在增加，所以我们还需要一间教室。

entries.en: I believe the seller is on the level, but I still want to see the receipt.
entries.zh: 我相信卖家没有耍花招，不过我仍想看看收据。

entries.en: The buyer paid cash on the line and collected the bicycle that afternoon.
entries.zh: 买家当即付了现金，并在当天下午取走了自行车。

entries.en: The novel follows a young salesman on the make who treats every friendship as a business opportunity.
entries.zh: 小说讲述一个野心勃勃的年轻推销员，他把每段友谊都当成做生意的机会。

entries.en: The successful film festival put the small seaside town on the map.
entries.zh: 那次成功的电影节让这座海滨小镇出了名。

entries.en: Her advice was on the mark, especially the suggestion to shorten the introduction.
entries.zh: 她的建议很中肯，尤其是缩短引言的那一条。

entries.en: The house had been on the market for months before anyone arranged a viewing.
entries.zh: 那栋房子挂牌出售好几个月后，才有人预约看房。

entries.en: My ankle is on the mend, though I still avoid the steep path home.
entries.zh: 我的脚踝正在好转，不过我回家时仍然避开那条陡路。

entries.en: The committee passed the routine proposal on the nod and moved to the next item.
entries.zh: 委员会没有争论就通过了那项例行提案，接着讨论下一项议程。

entries.en: I couldn't answer the door because I was on the phone to the repair shop.
entries.zh: 我当时正在给维修店打电话，所以没法去开门。

entries.en: We were on the point of leaving when the missing keys turned up.
entries.zh: 我们正要出发时，那串找不到的钥匙出现了。

entries.en: The cat was on the prowl again, peering behind every flowerpot in the garden.
entries.zh: 那只猫又在四处搜寻，朝花园里每个花盆后面张望。

entries.en: The long silence kept her on the rack while she waited for news of the missing boat.
entries.zh: 等待失踪小船的消息时，长时间没有音信让她备受煎熬。

entries.en: In the cartoon, a robot goes on the rampage and knocks over the market stalls.
entries.zh: 在那部动画片里，一个机器人横冲直撞，撞翻了市场上的摊位。

entries.en: The first few correct answers suggested that our new approach was on the right track.
entries.zh: 最初几道题答对了，这说明我们的新方法方向是对的。

entries.en: The storm left the fishing boat on the rocks below the empty lighthouse.
entries.zh: 风暴过后，渔船搁在那座空无人烟的灯塔下方的礁石上。

entries.meaningZh: 濒于失败的；处于困境的
entries.en: With two major orders cancelled, the little furniture business was on the ropes.
entries.zh: 两笔大订单被取消后，那家小家具企业濒临倒闭。

entries.en: In the film, the thieves remain on the run after abandoning their broken van.
entries.zh: 在那部电影里，窃贼丢下坏掉的货车后仍然在逃。

entries.en: A neighbour was already on the scene when the first fire engine arrived.
entries.zh: 第一辆消防车到达时，一位邻居已经在事发现场了。

entries.en: The plan stayed on the shelf because nobody could find the money to fund it.
entries.zh: 因为没人能找到资金，那项计划一直被搁置着。

entries.en: We hired the carpenter on the strength of a neighbour's recommendation.
entries.zh: 我们根据一位邻居的推荐雇用了那名木匠。

entries.en: She spent an hour on the telephone trying to arrange a replacement delivery.
entries.zh: 她打了一个小时的电话，试图安排重新送货。

entries.en: We planned a night on the town, starting with dinner and ending at a dance club.
entries.zh: 我们计划进城玩一晚，先吃晚饭，最后去一家舞蹈俱乐部。

entries.en: Our little team won three games on the trot before finally losing to the visitors.
entries.zh: 我们的小队连赢了三场，最后才输给客队。

entries.en: The old bridge was on the verge of collapse, so the path was closed.
entries.zh: 那座旧桥眼看就要坍塌，因此小路被封闭了。

entries.en: I'm on the wagon this month, so I'll have sparkling water with dinner.
entries.zh: 我这个月戒酒，所以晚饭时喝气泡水。

entries.en: The supervisor was on the warpath after finding paint spilled across the new carpet.
entries.zh: 主管发现新地毯上洒满了颜料，气得大发雷霆。

entries.en: The old paper timetable is on the way out as more passengers use the app.
entries.zh: 越来越多的乘客使用应用程序，那种旧式纸质时刻表即将被淘汰。

entries.en: I'm on the wrong side of forty, but I still enjoy learning a new dance.
entries.zh: 我已过四十岁，不过仍然喜欢学一种新的舞蹈。

entries.en: We realised we were on the wrong track when the figures stopped matching the receipts.
entries.zh: 当数字开始与收据对不上时，我们意识到思路错了。

entries.en: I stood on tiptoe to reach the last mug on the highest shelf.
entries.zh: 我踮起脚尖，去够最高一层架子上的最后一只马克杯。

entries.en: The children crept on tiptoes past the room where the baby was sleeping.
entries.zh: 孩子们踮着脚尖，悄悄走过婴儿正在睡觉的房间。

entries.en: Someone had left a wet umbrella on top of my carefully folded coat.
entries.zh: 有人把一把湿伞放在了我仔细叠好的外套上。

entries.en: I felt on top of the world when my older sister finally came home.
entries.zh: 姐姐终于回家时，我觉得幸福极了。

entries.en: The revised schedule kept the building project on track despite a week of rain.
entries.zh: 虽然下了一周的雨，调整后的日程仍使建筑项目按目标推进。

entries.en: Several sketches are on view beside the artist's finished paintings.
entries.zh: 艺术家的成品画旁边正在展出几幅素描。

entries.en: The sailor on watch noticed a light flashing beyond the harbour wall.
entries.zh: 值班水手注意到港口防波堤外有一盏灯在闪烁。

entries.en: The anonymous donor and our former neighbour turned out to be one and the same.
entries.zh: 那位匿名捐赠者原来就是我们以前的邻居。

entries.en: The cupboard held nothing other than a cracked bowl and a bag of rice.
entries.zh: 橱柜里除了一只裂碗和一袋米，什么也没有。

entries.en: The lift was out of action, so we carried the boxes up four flights of stairs.
entries.zh: 电梯不能用了，我们只好把箱子搬上四段楼梯。

entries.en: I reached the platform out of breath just as the train doors opened.
entries.zh: 火车门刚打开，我就气喘吁吁地赶到了站台。

entries.en: It was out of character for him to leave without saying goodbye.
entries.zh: 不告而别不像他一贯的作风。

entries.en: A damaged cable left the old projector out of commission for the whole weekend.
entries.zh: 一根损坏的电缆让旧投影仪整个周末都无法使用。

entries.en: After months without exercise, I felt out of condition on the first hill.
entries.zh: 几个月没有锻炼，刚爬第一座小山我就觉得体能不行了。

entries.en: The shopping trolley rolled out of control down the sloping car park.
entries.zh: 购物车失控地顺着倾斜的停车场滑了下去。

entries.en: The hikers were out of danger once they reached the shelter above the rising water.
entries.zh: 徒步者到了上涨水位上方的避难处后，就脱离了危险。

entries.en: The background was clear, but every face in the photograph was out of focus.
entries.zh: 照片的背景很清楚，可每张脸都没有对上焦。

entries.en: The wooden puppet's knee was out of joint, so one leg hung at an odd angle.
entries.zh: 木偶的膝关节脱节了，因此一条腿以奇怪的角度垂着。

entries.en: The bright plastic sign looked out of keeping with the quiet stone courtyard.
entries.zh: 那块鲜艳的塑料招牌看起来与安静的石砌庭院很不协调。

entries.en: The new shift pattern threw our household routine out of kilter.
entries.zh: 新的轮班安排打乱了我们家的日常作息。

entries.en: One tile was out of line with the others along the kitchen wall.
entries.zh: 厨房墙上有一块瓷砖没有与其他瓷砖排齐。

entries.en: The model's tiny wheels looked out of proportion to its enormous body.
entries.zh: 模型的轮子很小，与庞大的车身不成比例。

entries.en: The automatic door was out of service after its sensor failed.
entries.zh: 传感器失灵后，那扇自动门就不能使用了。

entries.en: The lid had bent out of shape and would no longer fit the tin.
entries.zh: 盖子已经弯曲变形，再也盖不上那个铁罐了。

entries.en: I kept marching out of step until I started listening to the drum.
entries.zh: 开始留意鼓声之前，我行进的步伐总是不合拍。

entries.en: The proposal seemed out of step with what residents had asked for at the meeting.
entries.zh: 那项提议似乎与居民在会上提出的要求不一致。

entries.en: The subtitles were out of sync with the video after I changed the playback speed.
entries.zh: 我改变播放速度后，字幕就与视频不同步了。

entries.en: Once we decided to walk, parking fees were out of the picture.
entries.zh: 一旦决定步行，停车费就与我们的安排无关了。

entries.en: The manager seemed out of touch with the problems faced by staff on the night shift.
entries.zh: 经理似乎不了解夜班员工面临的问题。

entries.en: The violin was so badly out of tune that we stopped the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 那把小提琴走调得太厉害，我们只好停止排练。

entries.en: The old drinking fountain has been out of use since the pipes were removed.
entries.zh: 水管被拆除后，那座旧饮水喷泉就一直没有再使用。

entries.en: She asked the pharmacist whether the cream was sold over the counter.
entries.zh: 她问药剂师，那种乳膏是否无需处方就能购买。

entries.meaningZh: 过了巅峰期的；在衰退中的
entries.en: The singer refused to believe he was over the hill and began rehearsing for another tour.
entries.zh: 那位歌手不肯相信自己已过巅峰期，又开始为下一轮巡演排练。

entries.en: With the roof repaired and the walls dry, we felt we were over the hump.
entries.zh: 屋顶修好、墙壁干透后，我们觉得最困难的阶段已经过去了。

entries.en: The children were over the moon when we told them about the camping trip.
entries.zh: 听我们说起那次露营旅行，孩子们高兴极了。

entries.en: Owing to a broken water pipe, the café could serve only cold drinks that morning.
entries.zh: 由于水管破裂，那天早晨咖啡馆只能供应冷饮。

entries.en: We moved the furniture into the hall preparatory to painting the sitting room.
entries.zh: 为了准备粉刷客厅，我们把家具搬进了门厅。

entries.en: Please check the address prior to posting the parcel, especially the apartment number.
entries.zh: 寄包裹前请核对地址，尤其是公寓号码。

entries.en: Pursuant to the club's rules, the secretary sent every member notice of the meeting.
entries.zh: 依照俱乐部的规则，秘书向每位会员发出了会议通知。

entries.en: We chose a small table rather than a sofa for the narrow balcony.
entries.zh: 我们给狭窄的阳台选了一张小桌子，而不是沙发。

entries.en: I left a message regarding the missing parcel and asked someone to call me back.
entries.zh: 我就丢失的包裹留了言，请对方回电话。

entries.en: He kept buying new equipment regardless of the shop's mounting debts.
entries.zh: 他不顾店里不断增加的债务，继续购买新设备。

entries.en: Right off the bat, she noticed that the two totals did not match.
entries.zh: 她一下子就注意到两个总数对不上。

entries.en: In the folktale, the villagers have gathered beside the great oak since time immemorial.
entries.zh: 在那则民间故事中，村民们自古以来就聚集在那棵大橡树旁。

entries.en: Subsequent to the inspection, the owner replaced the broken window and repaired the gate.
entries.zh: 检查之后，业主更换了破窗，并修好了大门。

entries.en: Thanks to a neighbour's spare key, we got inside before the rain began.
entries.zh: 多亏邻居有一把备用钥匙，我们在下雨前进了屋。

entries.meaningZh: 各种各样的东西；这个那个
entries.en: We spent the afternoon sorting this and that from the boxes in the attic.
entries.zh: 我们花了一个下午，整理阁楼箱子里的各种东西。

entries.en: The success of the fair depended to a large extent on the volunteers' careful planning.
entries.zh: 集市的成功在很大程度上依赖志愿者的周密筹划。

entries.en: The description fits our old kitchen to a tee, even down to the cracked blue tiles.
entries.zh: 那段描写与我们的旧厨房完全吻合，连裂开的蓝瓷砖都一样。

entries.en: To all appearances, the suitcase was empty, but a letter lay under the lining.
entries.zh: 从外表看，行李箱是空的，不过衬里下面藏着一封信。

entries.en: The fallen branch smashed the little wooden bench to bits.
entries.zh: 掉下来的树枝把那张小木凳砸得粉碎。

entries.en: I'm bored to death with this endless argument about where to put the cupboard.
entries.zh: 关于柜子该放在哪里的争论没完没了，我烦透了。

entries.en: The dripping tap drove me to distraction while I tried to finish the letter.
entries.zh: 我想把信写完时，水龙头不断滴水，弄得我心烦意乱。

entries.en: Keep a notebook to hand so you can write down the measurements immediately.
entries.zh: 把笔记本放在手边，这样就能立即记下测量结果。

entries.en: We searched every drawer to no avail; the receipt was still missing.
entries.zh: 我们翻遍了每个抽屉，还是白费力气；收据仍然找不到。

entries.en: The old cardboard box fell to pieces when I tried to lift it.
entries.zh: 我试着搬起那个旧纸箱时，它散成了碎片。

entries.en: The architect drew the garden to scale so we could see how the new path would fit.
entries.zh: 建筑师按比例缩小画出花园，让我们能看出新小路将如何布局。

entries.en: We all felt responsible to some degree for leaving the gate open.
entries.zh: 对于没有关大门这件事，我们大家都觉得自己多少有些责任。

entries.en: The thicker curtains reduced the noise to some extent, but we could still hear the traffic.
entries.zh: 较厚的窗帘在一定程度上减轻了噪声，不过我们仍能听见车流声。

entries.en: Stir the lemon juice into the dressing, then add a little pepper to taste.
entries.zh: 把柠檬汁拌入调味汁，再按口味加少许胡椒。

entries.en: Even when the score looked hopeless, the team kept fighting to the bitter end.
entries.zh: 即使比分已经让人绝望，球队仍然拼到了最后。

entries.en: We were chilled to the bone after waiting for the bus in the icy wind.
entries.zh: 在刺骨的寒风中等公交车后，我们冷得透骨。

entries.en: The apple was rotten to the core, although its skin still looked smooth.
entries.zh: 那只苹果已经烂到果核，尽管外皮看起来还很光滑。

entries.en: The company cut cleaning hours to the detriment of everyone who used the building.
entries.zh: 公司缩短了清洁工时，使所有使用那栋楼的人都受到不利影响。

entries.en: In the song, the sailor promises to remember his hometown to the end of time.
entries.zh: 在那首歌里，水手许诺永远记住自己的家乡。

entries.en: She focused on the border pattern to the exclusion of every other detail in the painting.
entries.zh: 她只顾看画中的边框图案，忽略了所有其他细节。

entries.en: The storm damaged the roof to the extent of exposing the wooden rafters.
entries.zh: 风暴把屋顶损坏到了露出木椽的程度。

entries.en: During the parade, the drummers moved to the fore and led the procession.
entries.zh: 游行时，鼓手们走到了前面，领着队伍前进。

entries.en: She stayed loyal to the little theatre to the last, even when its audience dwindled.
entries.zh: 即使观众越来越少，她也始终支持那家小剧院。
